commands.name: python_certified
commands.summary: Finalize certification state after approval.
commands.notes: Run only after receiving CERTIFY: APPROVED.

commands.name: agent_id
commands.summary: Generate a session-scoped agent id.

commands.name: agent_manage
commands.summary: Create, archive, or delete agent files.
commands.notes: Add --owner-id to record the actor managing another agent.

commands.name: agent_checkin
commands.summary: Check in an agent and mark the profile active.
commands.notes: Metadata fields are optional but recommended.

commands.name: agent_checkout
commands.summary: Check out an agent and mark the profile inactive.

commands.name: agent_status
commands.summary: Report agent profile status and current branch.
commands.notes: Includes branch_error when current_branch is unavailable.

commands.name: branch_init
commands.summary: Initialize branch-scoped state and queues.

commands.name: branch_switch
commands.summary: Switch the active branch pointer.

commands.name: branch_clone
commands.summary: Clone branch state and work queues into a new branch.
commands.notes: Use --activate to switch to the new branch.

commands.name: branch_copy_context
commands.summary: Copy branch context records into another branch.
commands.notes: Use --preserve-repo-state to keep scan counters.

commands.name: branch_copy_work
commands.summary: Copy branch work queues into another branch.
commands.notes: Use --preserve-state to keep in_progress or leased states.

commands.name: branch_delete_context
commands.summary: Delete context records for a branch.
commands.notes: Use --include-repo-state to remove the repo_state record too.

commands.name: branch_delete_work
commands.summary: Clear branch work queues.
commands.notes: Resets epics/stories/tasks queues to empty.

commands.name: branch_delete
commands.summary: Hard-delete a branch (drop SQLite tables and remove registry records).
commands.notes: Drops branch-scoped SQLite tables and removes the branch registry entry.

commands.name: repo_state_assess
commands.summary: Assess repo lifecycle stage and tooling policy.

commands.name: environment_check
commands.summary: Collect OS/runtime/tool availability and optionally persist.

commands.name: onboarding_bundle
commands.summary: Generate a consolidated onboarding bundle of docs.
commands.notes: Allowed before certification.

commands.name: agent_onboarding_start
commands.summary: Select a career and create the agent profile.
commands.notes: Defaults to developer when no career is provided.

commands.name: onboarding_bundle_restore
commands.summary: Restore selected onboarding docs from a bundle snapshot.
commands.notes: Requires explicit paths; refuses overwrite unless allowed.

commands.name: scan
commands.summary: Scan repo for ctx freshness and emit tasks.

commands.name: context_profiles_survey
commands.summary: Survey and build context profiles from ctx JSON.

commands.name: context_profiles_read
commands.summary: Read a named context profile and emit ctx bundle.

commands.name: context_profiles_review
commands.summary: Record a profile review and emit optimize/prune tasks.

commands.name: context_profiles_resurvey
commands.summary: Process resurvey_context_profile tasks.

commands.name: context_architecture_survey
commands.summary: Build architecture_context record from directory ctx.

commands.name: context_architecture_check
commands.summary: Check architecture context freshness.

commands.name: context_architecture_resurvey
commands.summary: Process resurvey_architecture_context tasks.

commands.name: context_component_survey
commands.summary: Build component_contexts record from directory ctx.

commands.name: context_component_check
commands.summary: Check component context freshness.

commands.name: context_component_resurvey
commands.summary: Process resurvey_component_contexts tasks.

commands.name: work_item_add
commands.summary: Add a work item to global work queues.
commands.notes: work_id is auto-generated when omitted.

commands.name: work_item_move
commands.summary: Move a work item between global buckets.

commands.name: work_item_bulk_move
commands.summary: Move multiple work items between buckets.
commands.notes: Provide --work-ids or --quantity to select items.

commands.name: work_item_close
commands.summary: Close a work item and move it to completed.

commands.name: work_item_claim
commands.summary: Claim a work item by moving it into an active state.
commands.notes: Defaults to ready -> active with state in_progress.

commands.name: work_item_complete
commands.summary: Complete a work item and move it to a terminal state.
commands.notes: Defaults to active -> completed with state done.

commands.name: work_queue_list
commands.summary: List work queues with optional filters.
commands.notes: Supports bucket, work_type, state, and work_id filters.

commands.name: work_queue_add
commands.summary: Add a work item to a per-agent queue.
commands.notes: work_id is auto-generated when omitted.

commands.name: work_item_global_to_branch
commands.summary: Move a global work item into branch queues.

commands.name: work_item_branch_to_global
commands.summary: Move a branch work item into global queues.

commands.name: work_item_agent_to_branch
commands.summary: Move a per-agent work item into branch queues.

commands.name: work_item_agent_to_global
commands.summary: Move a per-agent work item into global queues.

commands.name: ticket_promote
commands.summary: Promote a GitHub ticket markdown into work queues.
commands.notes: work_id is auto-generated when omitted.

commands.name: validate
commands.summary: Validate schemas and required artifacts.

commands.name: memory_add
commands.summary: Add a memory entry to user or system store.
commands.notes: User memory requires explicit user request.

commands.name: memory_update
commands.summary: Update a memory entry.

commands.name: memory_remove
commands.summary: Remove a memory entry.
commands.notes: Removes entries entirely (no soft delete).

commands.name: memory_read
commands.summary: Read memory entries.
commands.notes: Use --recent to limit output.

commands.name: command_registry_validator
commands.summary: Validate command registry tables in SQLite.
commands.notes: Use --system-db/--user-db to override default db paths.

commands.name: command_registry_generate
commands.summary: Generate command registries in SQLite.
commands.notes: Uses command_manifest.json by default; override with --manifest-path.

spec.purpose: Generate command registry tables in SQLite.
spec.returns: Registry payloads for user and system.

commands.name: command_registry_describe
commands.summary: Describe command registry entries without exposing paths.
commands.notes: Paths are hidden by default; use command_registry_path for a single path.

spec.purpose: Return detailed command registry records with paths redacted.

parameters.name: actor_id
parameters.description: Actor identifier recorded in CRUD logs.

spec.returns: Minified JSON plus structured command descriptors.

commands.name: command_registry_path
commands.summary: Resolve a single command's script path and entrypoint.
commands.notes: Path access is restricted to this single-command tool.

spec.purpose: Return the script path for one command registry entry.

parameters.name: actor_id
parameters.description: Actor identifier recorded in CRUD logs.

spec.returns: Minified JSON plus script path and entrypoint.

commands.name: lock_acquire
commands.summary: Acquire a lease lock for a file, dir, or resource key.
commands.notes: Use --resource for explicit lock keys; TTL defaults to policy.

commands.name: lock_release
commands.summary: Release a lease lock for a file, dir, or resource key.
commands.notes: Use --resource for explicit lock keys.

commands.name: lock_status
commands.summary: List lease locks by owner or resource filter.
commands.notes: Supports filters for resource, lock_group_id, and ticket_id.

commands.name: sqlite_crud
commands.summary: CRUD interface for SQLite tables via registry enforcement.
commands.notes: Payload JSON is required for create/update operations. action selects the script.

spec.purpose: Execute CRUD operations against SQLite tables with registry enforcement.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Script action name within the operation folder.

parameters.name: table_name
parameters.description: Registered table name for CRUD operations.

parameters.name: actor_id
parameters.description: Actor identifier recorded in CRUD and log metadata.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: Optional transaction identifier for grouping operations.

spec.returns: CRUD output payload plus log identifiers.

commands.name: sqlite_query
commands.summary: Execute registered SQLite query scripts via the query registry.
commands.notes: Queries must be registered in db_query_registry for the target scope.

spec.purpose: Execute registered query scripts that may span multiple tables.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Optional JSON payload for the query script.

spec.returns: Query output payload plus log identifiers.

commands.name: self_context
commands.summary: Initialize or update self context records.
commands.notes: Use --init-self to create the self context file.

commands.name: skill_receipt
commands.summary: Write skill read receipts into self context.

commands.name: update_state
commands.summary: Update scan counters or work item state.
commands.notes: Internal maintenance helper.

commands.name: lease
commands.summary: Lock leasing helper (library module, not a CLI).
commands.notes: Do not call directly; used by tools.
